{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check number of unique sites
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Check if site and severity are associated
print("\nCross-tabulation of site vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity']))

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nNumber of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check how many patients were re-tested (i.e. have sample_seq > 1)
retested = df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]
print("\nNumber of re-tested patients:", retested['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
